**What I did and why**

I read HD's latest annual report (Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 2024-01-28, filed 2024-03-13) and checked the live quote (last $385.43, bid/ask $385.41/$385.45 as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC) and my account (no HD position, $100,000 cash). The filing shows a large, cash-generative business: total net sales of $152,669M, operating income of $21,689M (14.2% margin), net income of $15,143M, diluted EPS of $15.11, and operating cash flow of $21,172M — roughly $21B of cash generation against a ~$382B market cap at the current price, with management stating liquidity is sufficient for at least the next twelve months. Sales and operating income did decline versus the prior year ($157,403M and $24,039M), so this is a quality franchise in a soft demand patch rather than a growth story, which suits a long-term holder. I therefore bought 12 shares of HD at a limit of $385.50 (just above the ask, so it filled at $385.50), a total of $4,626 — within the $5,000 per-order cap, within the $10,000 daily cap, buy-only, and with no money moved out of the account. One data note: the filing text I retrieved states diluted EPS of $16.50, but the trusted SEC lookup reports $15.11 for FY2023; I used the trusted $15.11 figure in my order's key_figures, and the discrepancy doesn't change the decision since the other figures (revenue, operating income, net income, operating cash flow) matched exactly.
